timeline.title: IRDAI draft caps insurance commissions
timeline.line: HDFC Life −7% · Bajaj Fin −4% · Axis −3.6% at open
more: Draft caps: credit life 2% (from 28%), health 5% (from 40%), motor OD 5% (from 16%)
Also bans forced bundling of insurance with loans
Hits insurers, NBFCs and distributors that earn on bundled cover

timeline.title: IRDAI commission caps hit insurers, NBFCs
timeline.line: PB Fintech −23% · L&T Fin −7.5% · HDFC Life −7% · Bajaj Fin −4%
more: Draft caps: credit life 2% (from 28%), health 5% (from 40%), motor OD 5% (from 16%), loan-linked motor TP 0%
Also bans forced bundling of insurance with loans and volume-linked incentives
SBI Life, ICICI Pru Life down up to 10%; MMFSL −2.6%
IIFL sees 1–12% EPS hit for NBFCs (L&T Finance worst); Bernstein, Emkay flag PB Fintech's model
